scope: Default intended settings for future runs, including solo, optional duet, Country and Jazz. Historical actual settings remain unchanged.

defaults.vocal_gender: Unselected; voice directed in the language prompt
defaults.exclude_styles: EDM, heavy dance beats, aggressive percussion, theatrical belting, excessive vocal runs, vocoder, chopped vocals

exception_rule: Use an explicit author-requested exception or a documented author-approved comparison; record changed values, reason and approval in that run. No silent model, Max Mode or inherited browser-setting changes.
